title: Location Tracking & GPS Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your location privacy risk score based on app permissions, device settings, and tracking behaviors. Get personalized protection tips.
description: Assess how exposed your location data is to apps, advertisers, and data brokers. This calculator evaluates your device settings, app permissions, and usage patterns to provide a personalized privacy risk score and actionable protection steps.

inputs.label: How many apps have location access?
inputs.helpText: Check Settings > Privacy > Location Services to count apps with location permissions

inputs.label: Location history enabled?
inputs.helpText: Google Location History, Apple Significant Locations, etc.

inputs.label: Location precision setting
inputs.helpText: iOS 14+ and Android 12+ offer approximate location options

inputs.label: Apps tracking in background?
inputs.helpText: Weather, maps, social media apps often track location continuously

inputs.label: Location-based ads enabled?
inputs.helpText: Google Ads, Apple's personalized ads based on location

outputFields.label: Active Tracking Sources
outputFields.description: Number of ways your location is being tracked

formula: let score = 0; let sources = 0; if (appsWithLocation > 0) { score += Math.min(appsWithLocation * 3, 30); sources++; } if (locationHistoryEnabled === 'yes') { score += 20; sources++; } else if (locationHistoryEnabled === 'partial') { score += 10; sources++; } else if (locationHistoryEnabled === 'unknown') { score += 15; sources++; } if (socialMediaSharing === 'always') { score += 15; sources++; } else if (socialMediaSharing === 'sometimes') { score += 8; sources++; } else if (socialMediaSharing === 'rarely') { score += 3; sources++; } if (precisionSetting === 'precise') { score += 10; } else if (precisionSetting === 'unknown') { score += 8; } if (backgroundTracking) { score += 15; sources++; } if (adPersonalization) { score += 10; sources++; } score = Math.min(score, 100); let level = 'Low'; if (score >= 70) level = 'High'; else if (score >= 40) level = 'Medium'; return { riskScore: score, riskLevel: level, exposureCount: sources };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your location privacy risk by analyzing app permissions, system settings, sharing behaviors, and tracking features. Higher scores indicate more ways your location data can be collected, stored, and potentially shared with third parties including advertisers, data brokers, and government agencies.
tips: Review location permissions regularly and revoke access for apps that don't need it
Use 'approximate location' instead of precise GPS when possible
Turn off location history in Google, Apple, and social media accounts
Disable location-based advertising in your device privacy settings
Consider using a privacy-focused browser to prevent location tracking during web browsing

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good location privacy practices. Your location data exposure is minimal.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate location tracking. Consider tightening permissions and disabling unnecessary features.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant location exposure. Multiple apps and services are tracking your movements.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Extensive location tracking. Immediate privacy audit recommended to reduce exposure.
